caption: The drawing features a detailed technical illustration of a one-piece outfit, depicted on an off-white background. The main garment in the center is a long-sleeved jumpsuit with a checkered or grid-like pattern in reddish-brown ink. The jumpsuit has a high collar, button-down front, and a belt-like detail at the waist. It is drawn without a visible face or hands, as if displayed on an invisible mannequin. Two smaller, simpler drawings appear in the upper right section: one is a back view of the same jumpsuit, showing the garment with a plain outline and minimal details, and the other is a small rectangular detail of the waistband or belt section. There are a few additional faint lines and a patch of grid lines drawn in the lower right area, likely to reference the pattern on the fabric. The signature "M. Conebos" is written at the lower right corner. The entire composition uses fine lines in shades of brown and red, giving a technical, schematic quality to the illustration.
